title: Transport Layer
markdown:
The **Transport Layer** (Layer 4) accepts data from the session layer, breaks it into smaller units if necessary, and ensures **process-to-process (end-to-end)** delivery of complete messages.

### Primary Responsibilities

- **Service-Point (Port) Addressing** — Ensures messages reach the specific application/process on a multi-tasking host using port numbers.
- **Segmentation & Reassembly** — Divides messages into numbered segments and reassembles them correctly at the destination.
- **Connection Control** — Supports connectionless (UDP) or connection-oriented (TCP) transmissions.
- **Flow & Error Control** — Enforces end-to-end flow control and error recovery across the entire path.
